info.title: API.SH: ClassicCars.com
info.description: The ClassicCars.com API from API.SH: public ClassicCars.com data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A ClassicCars.com auction house (name, city/state, page link) and its vehicles for sale, with the site's sorts and page sizes. Each vehicle as in /classiccars/v1/search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/classiccars-auction-house

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The auction house id, e.g. `1201` (from a listing's seller or /classiccars/v1/dealers).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
ClassicCars.com's dealer directory: without `region`, every state and country with listed dealers and how many; with `region`, the dealers there with business name, address, country code, phone, dealer id, type (dealer or auction house) and inventory link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/classiccars-dealers

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: A region slug from the list, e.g. `california-united-states`, `texas-united-states`, `canada`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One ClassicCars.com listing: CC number, title, year, make, model, price and price text (OBO), location, exterior and interior colour, transmission, engine, drive train, odometer, title status, every detail row the listing shows (conditions, seat material, engine history...), full description, all photos and videos, and the seller: dealers and auction houses with name, address, website, inventory link and contact phone; private sellers only as "Private Seller" (phone numbers in their descriptions are hidden). `latest=true` with search params returns the first current listing of that search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/classiccars-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Return the first current listing of a search made with the other params (e.g. `make=Ford`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every make ClassicCars.com's search offers with its models (use them as `make` and `model` on /search). `make` narrows to one make.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/classiccars-makes

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Classic and collector vehicles for sale on ClassicCars.com with every filter of the site's advanced search: keywords, make, model, year range, price range, country and state, ZIP radius, vehicle type, seller type (private, dealer, auction) and its sorts and page sizes. Each listing: id and CC number, title, year, make, model, price (and the site's price text, e.g. OBO or Auction Vehicle), currency, location, description snippet, badge, seller type, featured flag, image and link. `total` and `pages` are the site's counts. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/classiccars-search

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State or province name, with `country`, e.g. `California`.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: ZIP or postal code to search around.

parameters.name: sellers
parameters.description: Only these seller types, comma separated: `private`, `dealer`, `auction` (default all).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field (default: the site's own order).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
